```xml
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<robot name="chest_with_lid">

  <!-- Chest body -->
  <link name="body">
    <visual>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.25" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.57 0.36 0.5"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="brown">
        <color rgba="0.55 0.27 0.07 1"/>
      </material>
    </visual>
    <collision>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.25" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.57 0.36 0.5"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>
    <inertial>
      <mass value="20.0"/>
      <!-- Inertia of a solid box: Ixx = (1/12) m (h^2 + d^2) etc. -->
      <inertia ixx="0.20875" ixy="0.0" ixz="0.0"
               iyy="0.20875" iyz="0.0"
               izz="0.104375"/>
    </inertial>
  </link>

  <!-- Lid -->
  <link name="lid">
    <visual>
      <!-- Lid thickness 0.02 m, centered on its own frame -->
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.01" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.57 0.36 0.02"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="brown"/>
    </visual>
    <collision>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.01" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.57 0.36 0.02"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>
    <inertial>
      <mass value="5.0"/>
      <inertia ixx="0.001875" ixy="0.0" ixz="0.0"
               iyy="0.001875" iyz="0.0"
               izz="0.001125"/>
    </inertial>
  </link>

  <!-- Hinge joint for the lid -->
  <joint name="lid_hinge" type="revolute">
    <!-- Origin is at the back top edge of the chest body:
         X = 0 (center width)
         Y = +depth/2 = +0.18 m (back side)
         Z = height = 0.5 m (top surface) -->
    <origin xyz="0 0.18 0.5" rpy="0 0 0"/>
    <parent link="body"/>
    <child link="lid"/>
    <axis xyz="1 0 0"/> <!-- rotate about X (width) axis -->
    <limit effort="100" velocity="1.0" lower="0" upper="1.5708"/>
    <dynamics damping="0.1" friction="0.1"/>
  </joint>

</robot>
```
